note: A narrow grass-and-gravel opening at the end of a 200-ft spur off the west side of Summit Road, 0.46 mile from Anderson Trail, somewhat secluded. The agency says it holds 'one small camper trailer' and describes an 'uneven access road with water bars'; the site is moderately sloped. Summit Road is a ridge-top forest road, about 3.5 miles from State Route 4006 off PA 915 (North Valley Road). Pack out trash. State forest roads are not plowed in winter. --Claude
